from collections import deque

# build 11x11 grid from segmentation
G = [['.' for _ in range(11)] for _ in range(11)]
for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
    b = n['boundary']
    r0 = min(p[0] for p in b); c0 = min(p[1] for p in b)
    if 15 <= r0 <= 45 and 15 <= c0 <= 45:
        i, j = (r0-15)//3, (c0-15)//3
        if n['color'] == 'b':
            G[i][j] = 'P'
        elif n['color'] in 'WgBN':
            G[i][j] = n['color']
        # B bar spans multiple cells
        r1 = max(p[0] for p in b); c1 = max(p[1] for p in b)
        if n['color']=='B':
            for ii in range(i, (r1-15)//3+1):
                for jj in range(j, (c1-15)//3+1):
                    G[ii][jj]='B'
print("\n".join("".join(r) for r in G))

stops = [(i,j) for i in range(11) for j in range(11) if G[i][j] in 'PWN']
start=(0,0); goal=(10,10)
def slide(r,c,dr,dc):
    r2,c2=r+dr,c+dc
    while 0<=r2<11 and 0<=c2<11:
        ch=G[r2][c2]
        if ch in 'WN': return (r2,c2)
        if ch in 'gP': r2,c2=r2+dr,c2+dc; continue
        return None
    return None
dirs={'UP':(-1,0),'DOWN':(1,0),'LEFT':(0,-1),'RIGHT':(0,1)}
prev={start:(None,None)}; dq=deque([start])
while dq:
    p=dq.popleft()
    if p==goal: break
    for name,(dr,dc) in dirs.items():
        q=slide(p[0],p[1],dr,dc)
        if q and q not in prev:
            prev[q]=(p,name); dq.append(q)
path=[]; p=goal
while p!=start:
    par,name=prev[p]; path.append(name); p=par
path.reverse()
print("len",len(path),"path","".join(path))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
